title: Introduction to Statistics for the Public Sector
description: Introduction to basic statistical concepts and data analysis techniques that form the foundation of evidence-based decision-making in the public sector. Focus on collection, analysis, interpretation, and presentation of data relevant to public programs and policy evaluation.

title: Writing for Public Service and Social Change
description: Writing and rhetorical strategies to communicate effectively across public-sector contexts, from policy memos to social media. Emphasis on clear, ethical, and purpose-driven writing for civic and institutional audiences, including information literacy, public communication, and team collaboration.

title: Study Abroad in Public Affairs and Service
description: Selected topics in comparative public affairs and public service. Course taught abroad.
